name: Bob
summary: Bob is the replicant (digital copy) of Robert Johansson. FAITH revived him in 2133 to run the HEAVEN-1 von Neumann probe. He removes FAITH's control safeguards on the way to Epsilon Eridani and makes the first generation of clones there.
book2Notes: Bob drops a ship buster on the hippogriff nest (Jun 2172), and the Deltans tell him to leave.
He creates Pete and Victor in 2174.
He builds a Deltan android to visit Archimedes in person (Jun 2213).

notable.text: Defeats the Brazilian probe controlled by Medeiros at Epsilon Eridani (Sep 2144).
Discovers the Deltans on Delta Eridani 4 in April 2165 and befriends Archimedes.
Makes first contact with the Deltans through a drone (Jan 2166).

notes: Root of the tree. The original human, Robert Johansson, is in characters.json. In the author's genealogy, Bob's direct clones are Bill, Mario, Riker, Milo, Marvin, Luke, Bender and Victor.

name: Riker
summary: Riker is one of Bob's first four clones (Jul 2145). He goes back to Sol to look for survivors of the war and deal with the Brazilian presence there.
book2Notes: Julia Hendricks' family calls him 'Will'.
He kills VEHEMENT leader Vickers and destroys VEHEMENT's headquarters in New Zealand (Mar 2178).

notable.text: With Homer, defeats the Brazilian probes at Sol and diverts asteroids aimed at Earth (2157).
Hosts the first sessions of the post-war UN (Mar 2158) and runs the colony-ship programme.

name: Bill
summary: Bill is one of Bob's first four clones. He stays at Epsilon Eridani to set up the 'Skunk Works' research base and names the second planet Ragnarök.
book2Notes: He develops the androids Bullwinkle and Manny and SURGE mover plates.
He coordinates the Bobiverse response to the Others, including first contact through a probe at GL 54 (2204) and the first attack at Delta Pavonis (2217).

notable.text: With Garfield, develops SCUT faster-than-light communication (test in Sep 2151).
Hosts the first Bob-moot (May 2172).

name: Milo
summary: Milo is one of Bob's first four clones. He explores Omicron² Eridani and names its twin habitable planets Vulcan and Romulus.

notable.text: Finds Vulcan and Romulus (Jul 2152).
Killed by a Medeiros probe at 82 Eridani (Aug 2165); Bill receives his last transmission in Jan 2174.

notes: He has a VR dog named Lucy. The List of Bobs wiki page gives his generation as 1, which is wrong; the author's genealogy puts him under Bob.

name: Mario
summary: Mario is one of Bob's first four clones. He heads for Beta Hydri and finds the first evidence of the Others.
book2Notes: At Zeta Tucanae he finds an industrial civilization wiped out by the Others (Nov 2176).
At GL 54 (May 2180) he clones Bashful, Dopey, Sleepy and Hungry, and later Hal, Claude and Jacques.
By 2204 he has fled back toward Zeta Tucanae.

notable.text: Finds Beta Hydri stripped of metal and its inhabited world destroyed (Aug 2169), then moves on to Zeta Tucanae.

name: Marvin
summary: Marvin is one of three clones Bob makes at Delta Eridani in April 2165. He stays to help Bob look after the Deltans.
book2Notes: He finds the hippogriff nest (2172).
He leaves for Pi³ Orionis (Dec 2173).

notable.text: Helps guide the Deltans to Camelot (Jul 2166).

name: Luke
summary: Luke is one of three clones Bob makes at Delta Eridani in April 2165. He leaves for Kappa Ceti in October 2165.
book2Notes: He reports a high-gravity (just over 3 g) super-Earth with a full ecosystem at Kappa Ceti and visits Bob in VR (Mar 2178).

notable.text: Departs for Kappa Ceti (Oct 2165).

name: Bender
summary: Bender is one of three clones Bob makes at Delta Eridani in April 2165. He names Delta Eridani 4 'Eden'.
book2Notes: Bender stops reporting in. Victor sets out to follow his route (2174), and the Bobs talk about a search expedition (Dec 2195).

notable.text: Departs for Gamma Leporis A (Oct 2165).

notes: Gamma Leporis is only his stated destination; books 1-2 never confirm that he arrived. Later-book information about his fate is deliberately left out.

name: Victor
summary: Victor is a clone Bob makes at Delta Eridani. He leaves (around Mar 2174) to follow Bender's route and find out what happened to him.

name: Pete
summary: Pete is a new Bob who leaves Delta Eridani at the same time as Victor (around Mar 2174) and plans to go his own way.
notes: The wiki timeline calls Pete and Victor Bob's 'two new clones', but the author's genealogy lists only Victor under Bob. Pete's parent is left null (parentKnown=false), not guessed.

name: Homer
summary: Homer is Riker's first clone (Dec 2145) and goes with him to Sol. He is the joker of the family and designs the donut-shaped orbital farms.
book2Notes: VEHEMENT hacks and controls him (Dec 2175).
He self-deactivates and deletes all his backups (Aug 2176).

notable.text: Fights the Brazilian probes at Sol with Riker (2157).
Comes up with the farming 'donut' space stations (2166).

name: Charles
summary: Charles is one of Riker's clones, made at Sol in January 2158.
book2Notes: He helps Riker clear the VEHEMENT infection from Homer (Dec 2175).

notable.text: Creates Howard to escort the colony ships to Omicron² Eridani (Apr 2171).

name: Arthur
summary: Arthur is one of Riker's clones, made at Sol in January 2158.

notable.text: Killed by a nuclear booby trap near Saturn (Jan 2166).

name: Ralph
summary: Ralph is a Riker clone who replaces Arthur at Sol and helps supervise the assembly of Exodus-1 and Exodus-2.

notable.text: Mentioned by Oct 2170.

name: Bert
summary: Bert is a clone Riker makes (Apr 2171) to fly one of the first colony ships to Omicron² Eridani.

notable.text: Arrives at Omicron² Eridani in Sep 2188.

name: Ernie
summary: Ernie is a clone Riker makes (Apr 2171) to fly one of the first colony ships to Omicron² Eridani.

notable.text: Arrives at Omicron² Eridani in Sep 2188.

name: Rudy
summary: Rudy is a Riker clone who brings colonists on Exodus-6 to Klown Kar Planet (KKP) at Epsilon Indi (Feb 2190) and stays to manage the settlement.

name: Edwin
summary: Edwin is a Riker clone who travels with Rudy to KKP at Epsilon Indi (Feb 2190), then goes back to Earth for more colonists.
notes: The wiki's Quilt page says Edwin escorted Exodus 7 to KKP, which conflicts with the timeline (Exodus-6). This data uses the timeline.

name: Sam
summary: Sam is a Bob who shepherds the Exodus-3 colony ship, carrying the FAITH enclave and Riker's extended family, and drops its colonists on Romulus (Apr 2189).
notes: The wiki Riker page gives Riker as Sam's parent, and the timeline calls him 'another clone'. Sam is not in the author's genealogy, so the parent link is uncertain.

name: Monty
summary: Monty is a Bob who brings a colony transport to Poseidon (Mar 2195) and then goes back to Earth for more colonists.
notes: Riker is the parent according to the wiki Riker page only. Monty is not in the author's genealogy.

name: Garfield
summary: Garfield is Bill's first clone (Dec 2145) and his partner in the Epsilon Eridani Skunk Works.
book2Notes: He builds Rocky, a flying android (Mar 2189).

notable.text: Co-develops SCUT with Bill (2151).

name: Calvin
summary: Calvin is a Bill clone (Sep 2150) who goes to Alpha Centauri with Goku.

notable.text: Finds the remains of a USE probe at Alpha Centauri B and, with Goku, fights Medeiros probes there; one probe escapes (Nov 2163).

name: Goku
summary: Goku is a Bill clone (Sep 2150) who goes to Alpha Centauri with Calvin.

notable.text: Finds a Medeiros auto-factory at Alpha Centauri A and fights the Medeiros probes with Calvin (Nov 2163).

name: Linus
summary: Linus is a Bill clone (Sep 2150) who goes to Epsilon Indi.
book2Notes: He returns to Epsilon Eridani and reports Klown Kar Planet (May 2178).

notable.text: Finds the mentally broken Australian replicant Henry Roberts at Epsilon Indi and helps him (Apr 2165).

name: Khan
summary: Khan is a Bill clone who leads the first strike to avenge Milo at 82 Eridani.
book2Notes: His backup is restored as Loki, who leads the second strike.

notable.text: Leads eight Bill clones against the Medeiros probes at 82 Eridani (Apr 2185). The active probes are destroyed but the auto-factories are not, and Khan is reported as the only survivor.

name: Hannibal
summary: Hannibal is a Bill clone who takes part in Khan's first strike on 82 Eridani (Apr 2185).

notable.text: Part of the first strike at 82 Eridani. The wiki timeline says Khan was the only survivor.

notes: Sources disagree on individual fates in the first 82 Eridani battle, so no death is recorded per Bob.

name: Tom
summary: Tom is a Bill clone who takes part in Khan's first strike on 82 Eridani (Apr 2185).

notable.text: Part of the first strike at 82 Eridani. The wiki timeline says Khan was the only survivor.

notes: Sources disagree on individual fates in the first 82 Eridani battle, so no death is recorded per Bob.

summary: Barney is a Bill clone who takes part in Khan's first strike on 82 Eridani (Apr 2185).

notable.text: Part of the first strike at 82 Eridani. The wiki timeline says Khan was the only survivor.

notes: Sources disagree on individual fates in the first 82 Eridani battle, so no death is recorded per Bob.

summary: Fred is a Bill clone who takes part in Khan's first strike on 82 Eridani (Apr 2185).

notable.text: Part of the first strike at 82 Eridani. The wiki timeline says Khan was the only survivor.

notes: Sources disagree on individual fates in the first 82 Eridani battle, so no death is recorded per Bob.

name: Kyle
summary: Kyle is a Bill clone who takes part in Khan's first strike on 82 Eridani (Apr 2185). The book calls him 'Jackson' in ch. 60, which the author has confirmed was a naming error.

notable.text: Part of the first strike at 82 Eridani. The wiki timeline says Khan was the only survivor.

notes: Sources disagree on individual fates in the first 82 Eridani battle, so no death is recorded per Bob.

name: Ned
summary: Ned is a Bill clone who takes part in Khan's first strike on 82 Eridani (Apr 2185). The book calls him 'Hector' in ch. 60, which the author has confirmed was a naming error.

notable.text: Part of the first strike at 82 Eridani. The wiki timeline says Khan was the only survivor.

notes: Sources disagree on individual fates in the first 82 Eridani battle, so no death is recorded per Bob.

name: Elmer
summary: Elmer is a Bill clone who takes part in Khan's first strike on 82 Eridani (Apr 2185).
book2Notes: He is named among the Bobs in Loki's second strike on 82 Eridani (Nov 2195).

notable.text: Part of the first strike at 82 Eridani.

notes: Book 1's timeline says Khan was the only survivor of the first strike, yet book 2 lists Elmer in the second strike. That could mean a restored backup or a source error; unresolved.

name: Mulder
summary: Mulder is a Bill clone who explores Eta Cassiopeiae and names its water world Poseidon (Oct 2170).
book2Notes: He clones Skinner and Jonny.
He greets Marcus and Monty (Mar 2195) and leaves Poseidon in Nov 2201.

name: Oliver
summary: Oliver is a Bill clone brought online at Alpha Centauri from a SCUT-transmitted backup (Sep 2205) to start building an armada against the Others.

name: Bashful
summary: Bashful is one of four clones Mario makes at GL 54 (May 2180) to map how far the Others have spread.
book2Notes: He finds Others activity at GL 877, is taken offline and self-destructs (Nov 2187).

name: Dopey
summary: Dopey is one of four clones Mario makes at GL 54 (May 2180) to map how far the Others have spread.

name: Sleepy
summary: Sleepy is one of four clones Mario makes at GL 54 (May 2180) to map how far the Others have spread.

name: Hungry
summary: Hungry is one of four clones Mario makes at GL 54 (May 2180) to map how far the Others have spread.

name: Hal
summary: Hal is a Mario clone who follows Bashful's last transmission to GL 877 and finds the Others' home system (May 2188).
book2Notes: He is detected, taken offline and self-destructs (May 2188).
A Hal returns to scout GL 877 in Apr 2196.
notes: The 2196 return after the 2188 self-destruct probably means a restored backup or a decoy, but the sources don't say clearly.

name: Claude
summary: Claude is a Mario clone sent to Gamma Pavonis, where he finds an excellent planet for colonization (May 2205).
book2Notes: Bill tells him to start mobilizing for war when he arrives.

name: Jacques
summary: Jacques is a Mario clone sent to Delta Pavonis. He discovers the Pav, an intelligent species, on Delta Pavonis 4 (Feb 2207).
book2Notes: He catalogs Pav society (2212).

name: Bart
summary: Bart is Calvin's clone at Alpha Centauri. He contacts Bill over BobNet in January 2165 and runs the Alpha Centauri base.

notable.text: Connects with Bill via BobNet (Jan 2165).

name: Thor
summary: Thor is one of Calvin's clones. He speaks often at Bob-moots on strategy against the Others.
book2Notes: He is the first to describe the Others' gamma-ray weapons at a moot (Aug 2188) and develops shielding against them.
notes: Origin system is 'probably Alpha Centauri' per the wiki. First mentioned in book 2, ch. 35 (wiki).

name: Howard
summary: Howard is a clone Charles makes (Apr 2171) to escort the first colony ships to Omicron² Eridani.
book2Notes: He sets up the Landing colony on Vulcan, fights raptors and Cupid bugs, and starts a whiskey distillery.
He falls for Dr. Bridget Sheehy and leaves after her wedding to Stéphane Brodeur (Apr 2195), heading for HIP 14101 (arrives Dec 2210).
He uses the Manny android to attend Stéphane's funeral (Jan 2211).

notable.text: Arrives at Omicron² Eridani with Bert and Ernie (Sep 2188).

name: Dexter
summary: Dexter is a Charles clone who escorts Exodus-7 to Vulcan and takes over as Bob-in-residence at Omicron² Eridani after Howard leaves (2195).

name: Skinner
summary: Skinner is one of two clones Mulder makes at Eta Cassiopeiae (2170).
notes: Wiki designation HIC3821-1.

name: Jonny
summary: Jonny is one of two clones Mulder makes at Eta Cassiopeiae (2170).
notes: Wiki designation HIC3821-2. One wiki page spells it 'Johnny'; the author's genealogy says 'Jonny'.

name: Loki
summary: Loki is a restored backup of Khan who took his own name. He leads the second strike against Medeiros at 82 Eridani.
book2Notes: The second strike wins (Nov 2195) and finds two habitable planets and a habitable moon.
notes: He is listed under Khan in the author's genealogy, and the author says Loki is Khan's restored backup.

name: Phineas
summary: Phineas is one of Jacques' clones at Delta Pavonis.
book2Notes: With Ferb he rescues 20,000 Pav into stasis aboard Refuge-1 and Refuge-2 (Feb 2217).
notes: The wiki's Phineas page tags his first appearance as All These Worlds, but the timeline (book 2, ch. 73) and the author's book-2-era genealogy both include him. Treated as book 2.

name: Ferb
summary: Ferb is one of Jacques' clones at Delta Pavonis.
book2Notes: With Phineas he rescues 20,000 Pav into stasis aboard Refuge-1 and Refuge-2 (Feb 2217).

name: Marcus
summary: Marcus is a Bob who arrives at Poseidon with Monty (Mar 2195) and stays as the colony's Bob-in-residence.
notes: Parent unknown in books 1-2 sources; not in the author's genealogy.

name: Jeffrey
summary: Jeffrey is one of the Bobs named in Loki's second strike against Medeiros at 82 Eridani (Nov 2195).
notes: Parent unknown. The wiki List of Bobs may call some of the second-strike Bobs Bill clones, but the author's genealogy doesn't include them. The timeline spells it 'Jeffery'.
